prerequisites: Basic knowledge of the fundamentals of mechanical engineering, especially machine parts and mechanisms.

learning_outcomes.text: Introduce students to the basic concepts of motor vehicles, their design, modeling, testing and production, including modern trends.
Acquire basic knowledge in the field of automotive engineering.

syllabus_topics: Conceptual development of vehicles. Basic classification of motor vehicles.
Arrangement of drive of vehicles, types of bodies. Driving limits.
Axles, their design principles. Suspension and damping systems.
Vehicle drive, engine, gearbox, axle, differential, cardan shafts.
Basic components of internal combustion engine.
Development trends of internal combustion engines, turbocharging, emission reduction, alternative fuels.
Autonomous vehicles, control and mechatronic systems. Assistive systems.
Motorsport as a part of automotive engineering.
Practical demonstration of software used in the automotive industry, CATIA, CREO, GT-Power, ANSYS, Matlab, Labview
Practical demonstration of internal combustion engines and the entire drive chain. Engine measurements on engine and cylinder dynamometer.
Measurement of vehicle centre of gravity, geometry, shock absorber tests. Demonstration of driving tests.
Motorsport, procedures used in the development of Formula Student.
assessment_rules: Classified credit is awarded on the basis of class participation and a final exam in elearning demonstrating the required knowledge. Obligatory participation in lessons is required. Reasonably missed lessons can only be replaced by an individual agreement with the teacher.
